import sys,os
from mir.core.capabilities.manager import CapabilityError
class CapabilityManager:
 def __init__(self,*a,**kw): pass
 def sync(self,*a,**kw):
  print('A',end=''); print('B',end='',file=sys.stderr); print('C',end='')
  raise CapabilityError('refused')
 finalize = sync
